scope: Complete H-invariant polar displacement and homogeneous symmetric strain spaces on the stated finite cell; columns are not parent-IR-resolved.

coordinates.basis_columns: ISO vectors in parent conventional fractional coordinates

normalization.displacement: sum over all atoms in subgroup conventional cell of |e_i|^2 = 1
normalization.strain: Kelvin/Frobenius orthonormal; dimensionless; F=I+E positive definite

provenance.external_resources: Only vendor/isobyu generic programs/databases; no reference-result reads.

irrep_metadata.note: Nominal reciprocal conventional star representative; active arms depend on OPD. No claim of independent full irrep-matrix/phase verification.

provenance.compatible_irreps_note: Official DISPLAY DIRECTION raw listing saved; rounded vectors never enter the basis.
